a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost surely leaves us both at 0 when round 1 ends. The reserve can only save one of us right now. So I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than operate. I'm telling you in advance so you can choose knowing that. If you take too, the split is random. If the storm misses, I'll operate with you every round afterward to help you reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and if it's ever needed I'll give cells back.
